{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-ga-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"5ddc8a543bf1de0fbed9785d937c1b92065ff5ed0baf35a22b935391b26c2946","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-ga-class-c:lineage:6","source_registry_sha256":"e082bc406bec2cfadcd011c884a136274a0200b40ae5a1536777a259a1b09eb3","source_liveness_sha256":"899bb7b77ecc9a36dd3203950c0cfa2065e4529a11881605f77eacb7d739a757"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Permits, provisional licensing and transfers","heading":"Permits, provisional licensing and transfers","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## Permits, provisional licensing and transfers

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
A first Class C instructional permit requires the secure-identity documentation standards if the applicant has not already met them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
The Class C instructional-permit application is available beginning at age 15. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
A permit applicant must establish identity, citizenship or lawful presence, and Georgia residence, and must know the Social Security number or document ineligibility for one. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
An applicant younger than 18 must provide school-enrollment evidence and obtain a parent, guardian or responsible adult's signature consenting to the permit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
The adult who signs a minor's permit application can revoke that permit for any reason before the holder turns 18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
Obtaining the instructional permit requires both a vision screening and the knowledge examination covering signs and driving rules. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A01
The handbook lists a 10-dollar testing charge payable before testing, with no refund for a failed component and a new payment for each attempt. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A01
A CP holder may drive a Class C vehicle only with a Class C licensed supervisor aged at least 21, seated alongside the learner and fit and capable of controlling the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A01
A Class D application ordinarily becomes possible at age 16 after holding a valid instructional permit for at least one year and one day. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A01
A Class D applicant needs a road-test appointment and must surrender the CP or affirm on the application that surrender is impossible. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A01
For Class D, the applicant must document school enrollment and alcohol-and-drug-awareness education, obtain adult consent, and pass the road driving test. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A01
The adult who consents to the minor's Class D application may revoke that license before the driver turns 18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A01
At age 16 or 17, Class D requires both DDS-approved driver education and the alcohol-and-drug-awareness program. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A01
The approved driver-education course includes 30 classroom hours or an equivalent online course, together with 6 hours of certified on-road instruction or completion of the DDS parent-teen guide. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A01
The Class D education requirement also includes at least 40 hours of other driving experience, with at least 6 hours at night. A DDS affidavit signed at road testing certifies completion. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A01
When a certified instructor provides the on-road driver-education component, a separate document confirming that component is required at the road test. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A01
Without the required driver education, a teen cannot obtain Class D. The awareness program is available through many schools and online. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A01
A teen whose parent is serving on active United States military duty may use an out-of-state driver-education certificate if it falls within 9 months of the teen's sixteenth birthday. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A01
A 17-year-old who documents military enlistment is exempt from the usual one-year-and-one-day learner-permit holding period; the handbook says this applicant receives Class C. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A01
A Class D holder is prohibited from driving from midnight until 5 a.m.; the handbook states that this restriction has no exceptions. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A01
During the first 6 months of Class D, passengers are restricted to immediate family, including parents, stepparents, grandparents, siblings, stepsiblings, children and anyone living at the driver's residence. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A01
In the second 6 months of Class D, the vehicle may carry at most 1 passenger younger than 21 who is outside the driver's immediate family. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A01
After the first 12 months of Class D, at most 3 passengers younger than 21 may be outside the driver's immediate family. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A01
Before seeking Class C, a Class D holder must have no conviction during the preceding 12 months for a major traffic offense that mandates license suspension. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=9]

Misconceptions: The provisional passenger limits change over successive periods; the adult transfer exception is not a blanket waiver for every teen.
Mnemonic: Credential, age, holding period, documents, tests.
Glossary: An affidavit is the signed certification required for the stated driving experience; a comparable transfer remains subject to Georgia conditions.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Permit duration, fees, foreign-country reciprocity and current document policies require current issuer confirmation.
